title: The Icosaxes Hexa: Bloom, Bud and Seed (working title)
idea: DICTO 2026-10-27: a stella jewel icosahedral Kagome-style network; 'the Hexa was the inspiration, not the shape; icosahedral was the idea'; DICTO chose Icosaxes and Unborn Axes.

pieces.Icosaxes: {|x|,|y|,|z| <= phi/2} intersected with {|x|+|y|+|z| <= phi^2/2}; volume 1 + 2*sqrt5/3; hexagons at distance phi^2/(2*sqrt3) = inradius of its icosahedron (edge 1)
pieces.Lotus Jewel Axes: Icosaxes with all 8 Tricaps removed (dents); volume sqrt5
pieces.Dodecaxes: Unborn Axes with 8 Tricap keys; volume 2

theorem_A: Twenty Icosaxes, one on each corner of a dodecahedron, each turned by the icosahedral rotation carrying (1,1,1) there, centres at distance d. First touch at d = phi^2*sqrt3/2: a cage of 20 meeting along the 30 dodecahedron edges, 12 open windows (genus 11). The 12 windows close at once at d = phi*sqrt3/2 = (1/phi) of first touch: a sealed shell round a hollow. The hollow fills at d = phi^2/(2*sqrt3) = 1/3 of first touch. With Lotus Jewel Axes: same first touch and windows, hollow fills at d = sqrt3/(2*phi) = 1/phi^3 of first touch (the Tricap tips meet).
proof_status: Exact (sympy): first touch by separating axes (face normals and edge cross products) between neighbours; window stop as a two-variable linear programme on the five-fold axis; hollow stops by the centre point. By symmetry: the last point of a window lies on its five-fold axis, the last point of the hollow is the centre; float sweeps (manifold3d unions) agree at every stop.
icosaxes_hexa: 8 Icosaxes on the corners of a cube round an Unborn Axes (golden split sites) = 9 Icosaxes passing through each other: each overlap sqrt5/24; what remains of the middle one is exactly an Unborn Axes; one closed solid, volume 9 + 6*sqrt5. Holds along the whole golden bond wherever the corner piece is at least as large as its partner (Kelvin onwards).
kagome_B: Icosaxes on (2Z)^3, Unborn Axes on (2Z+1)^3 (x phi/2). #17's rules (no piece in more than two clusters, no two clusters sharing more than one). cube8 (8 Icosaxes round an Unborn Axes) on the BCC anchor lattice: every Icosaxes in exactly two clusters, 8 neighbours (perfect, like #17's rhombohedron). octa7/octa6 BCC 74%; cuboctahedral FCC 42%; rhombic-dodecahedral 24%.
keyed: With Dodecaxes at the cluster centres, each Icosaxes dented towards its two centres (opposite hexagons) and keyed outward on six: no overlaps; this piece (placeholder name Keyaxes) has volume exactly phi^2 = (3+sqrt5)/2.

names_placeholder.bloom/bud/seed: Icosaxes Bloom, Icosaxes Bud, Icosaxes Seed; Lotus Jewel Bloom/Bud/Seed
